item.title: Ahn Cheol-soo: "Return-faction activists are turning the party into a shambles... Must be excluded from general election" (안철수 “복당 운동권이 당 쑥대밭 만들어…총선 배제해야”)
item.description:
Ahn Cheol-soo: "Return-faction activists are turning the party into a shambles... Must be excluded from general election" (안철수 “복당 운동권이 당 쑥대밭 만들어…총선 배제해야”)

People Power Party lawmaker Ahn Cheol-soo argued on the 12th that "the 'return-faction activists,' comparable to the Democratic Party's '86 movement faction,' are turning the party into a shambles" and that they should be excluded from nominations for the next general election. This was interpreted as targeting pro-Han (pro-Han Dong-hoon) lawmakers who are calling for the reinstatement of independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon, who was expelled from the party. (국민의힘 안철수 의원이 12일 “더불어민주당의 ‘86 운동권’에 버금가는 ‘복당 운동권’이 당을 쑥대밭으로 만들고 있다”며 차기 총선 공천에서 배제해야 한다는 취지로 주장했다. 당에서 제명된 무소속 한동훈 의원의 복당을 주장하는 친한(친한동훈)계 의원들을 겨냥한 것으로 해석됐다.)

At a press conference held that morning at the National Assembly in Yeouido, Seoul, Ahn said, "Those who serve a specific person outside the party and, to that end, engage in 'wrecker' tactics to divide the party must disappear from the People Power Party." Interpretations emerged that the "specific person outside the party" referred to independent lawmaker Han, and the "return-faction activists" referred to pro-Han lawmakers within the party. (안 의원은 이날 오전 서울 여의도 국회에서 기자회견을 열고 “당 밖의 특정인에게 봉사하고, 이를 위해 ‘렉커’질을 하며 당을 분열시키는 사람들은 국민의힘에서 없어져야 한다”며 이같이 밝혔다. 당 밖의 특정인은 무소속 한 의원을, 복당 운동권은 당내 친한계 의원들을 거론한 것 아니냐는 해석이 나왔다.)

Ahn said, "Winning the 2028 general election is our party's absolute task, and the 2030 presidential election is our party's paramount goal" and "Now is the right time to set clear goals and activate the special committee on organizational reinforcement." Party leader Kwon Young-se had reactivated the Special Committee on Organizational Reinforcement (Jogang Special Committee), which evaluates and selects party branch chairpersons, on the 10th. (안 의원은 “2028년 총선 승리는 우리 당의 절대 과제이고, 2030년 대선은 우리 당의 지상 목표”라며 “지금이 확실한 목표를 세우고 조강특위를 가동하는 적기”라고 했다. 장 대표는 지난 10일 당협위원장을 평가·선출하는 조직강화특별위원회(조강특위)를 재가동했다.)

Again targeting the pro-Han faction, he said, "They mobilize in groups to campaign against our party's candidates to make them lose elections, and they attack someone who testified truthfully in court by claiming he is 'inciting' and 'distorting.'" He added, "The People Power Party is fighting a war on two fronts: against the Lee Jae-myung government and against the 'return-faction activists.' The return-faction activists must be eradicated." Earlier, Ahn had testified as a witness in the trial of Daegu Mayor Choo Kyung-ho, a former party floor leader, regarding the December 3 martial law declaration, and was criticized by the pro-Han faction for doing so. (그는 재차 친한계를 겨냥해 “선거에 임한 우리 당 후보를 낙선시키기 위해 무리 지어 총출동하며, 법정에서 사실을 증언한 사람에게 ‘선동한다, 왜곡한다’며 난타하고 있다”며 “국민의힘은 이재명 정부, 그리고 ‘복당 운동권’이라는 두 개의 전선에서 전쟁을 치르고 있는 꼴이다. 복당 운동권을 근절해야 한다”고 했다. 앞서 안 의원은 당 원내대표를 맡았던 추경호 대구시장의 12·3 비상계엄 관련 재판에 증인으로 출석해 계엄 당일 상황에 대해 증언했다 친한계로부터 비판을 받았었다.)

Ahn also said, "Those who have left ethical stains on the People Power Party must be filtered out" and "If they deviate from the public's common sense, they must be boldly cut out and cleaned up." This was interpreted as targeting lawmakers Cho Kyoung-tae, Seo Beom-soo, Kwon Young-jin, and Jin Jong-oh, against whom disciplinary procedures have been initiated at the party's ethics committee. The four lawmakers were referred to the ethics committee over various controversies, but they share in common that they are non-establishment figures who have called for Chairman Kwon's resignation. (안 의원은 또 “국민의힘에 윤리적 오점을 남긴 분들은 걸러내야 한다”며 “국민의 상식선에 어긋나면 과감히 도려내고 정리해야 한다”고 말했다. 당 윤리위원회에 징계 절차가 개시된 조경태·서범수·권영진·진종오 의원을 향한 것이라는 해석이 나왔다. 네 의원은 각기 다른 논란으로 윤리위에 회부됐지만 장 대표 사퇴를 요구해온 비당권파라는 공통점이 있다.)

item.title: North Korea: "South Korea's Nuclear Submarine Ambitions Destabilize Security Environment... Capable of Responding with Unsurvivable Retaliatory Strikes" (北 “韓의 핵잠 보유기도, 안보환경 불안정 야기…생존불가능의 보복 공격 응대 가능”)
item.description:
North Korea: "South Korea's Nuclear Submarine Ambitions Destabilize Security Environment... Capable of Responding with Unsurvivable Retaliatory Strikes" (北 “韓의 핵잠 보유기도, 안보환경 불안정 야기…생존불가능의 보복 공격 응대 가능”)

North Korea stated on the 12th that "South Korea's nuclear submarine ambitions are amplifying instability in the regional security environment" and that "possessing unrivaled power to respond with unsurvivable, unrecoverable retaliatory strikes against the military ambitions of adversary states that touch our nation's strategic sovereignty and security is the most responsible choice for war deterrence." <<> In a statement issued through the Korean Central News Agency (KCNA) on the same day under the name of Jang Geum-cheol, First Vice Minister of Foreign Affairs and Director of the 10th Bureau, North Korea claimed that "South Korea's nuclear submarine development plan, agreed with Washington at Seoul's request, will further exacerbate instability in the Korean Peninsula region." <<> Jang Geum-cheol, in a statement titled "South Korea's Nuclear Submarine Ambitions, Emerging as a New Risk Factor in Asia-Pacific Regional Security, Are Doomed to Run Aground," said that "a few months ago, at the first meeting of the 'Future Defense Strategy Committee' held at the Naval Submarine Command in Jinhae, South Gyeongsang Province, South Korea's leader prattled that the nuclear submarine construction plan was an expression of the will to take responsibility for peace and security on the Korean Peninsula, thereby justifying nuclear submarine development." He added, "South Korea's persistent nuclear submarine ambitions can never be regarded as a defensive measure to counter anyone's 'threat.'" <<> Jang Geum-cheol stated, "Clearly, South Korea's gaze reaches toward ambitions beyond that," and "South Korea's ultimate goal is to break free from the constraints of the provisions banning nuclear fuel reprocessing and uranium enrichment, secure the right to produce nuclear materials, and lay the groundwork to ultimately leap toward nuclear armament." He further claimed, "South Korea's true intent, focused on nuclear submarine development with its own nuclear arming in sight, can never be diluted no matter how much it prattles about 'nuclear threats' or 'enhancing self-defense capabilities,'" and "South Korea's possession of nuclear submarines will serve as a preparatory stage in evolving the unavoidable U.S.-Japan-South Korea trilateral military alliance into a 'second AUKUS.'" <<> Jang Geum-cheol warned, "If the international community overlooks this, it will inevitably face a whirlwind of confrontation unleashed by a U.S.-led nuclear submarine alliance sweeping across the Asia-Pacific region, encompassing the waters around the Korean Peninsula, the Taiwan Strait, and the South China Sea." (북한은 12일 “한국의 핵잠수함 보유기도는 지역안보환경의 불안정성을 증폭시키고있다”며 “우리 국가의 전략적 주권안전을 건드리는 적수국들의 군사적 기도에 생존불가능,재생불가능의 보복공격으로 응대할수 있는 독보적인 힘의 보유는 전쟁억제를 위한 가장 책임적인 선택으로 될것”이라고 했다.)

item.title: Government's 1.6 Trillion Won AI Training Data... Much of It Unusable or Error-Prone (1.6조 들인 정부 AI 학습용 데이터... 상당수 못 쓰거나 오류 일으켜)
item.description:
Government's 1.6 Trillion Won AI Training Data... Much of It Unusable or Error-Prone (1.6조 들인 정부 AI 학습용 데이터... 상당수 못 쓰거나 오류 일으켜)

A significant portion of the data built by the government and public institutions to train AI (artificial intelligence) has been found to be of low quality—either unusable for training or capable of causing errors when used. (정부와 공공기관이 AI(인공지능)를 학습시키기 위해 구축한 데이터 상당수가 학습에 사용될 수 없거나 학습하면 오히려 오류를 일으킬 수 있는 저품질인 것으로 드러났다.)

According to an audit report titled "Audit of AI Industry Promotion Status (Focusing on AI Training Data Construction Projects)" released by the Board of Audit and Inspection (BAI) on the 12th, the government spent 1.6328 trillion won from 2017 to 2024 to build 908 types of AI training data, which were made public through the 'AI Hub' website operated by the Ministry of Science and ICT (MSIT) and the National Information Society Agency (NIA). This was done to enable private companies and research institutes to use the data for AI training. The data published there meet quality standards established by MSIT. (감사원이 12일 공개한 ‘인공지능 산업 육성 실태(AI 학습용 데이터 구축 사업 중심)’ 감사 보고서에 따르면, 정부는 2017년부터 2024년까지 1조6328억원을 들여 AI 학습용 데이터 908종을 구축하고, 이를 과학기술정보통신부와 한국지능정보사회진흥원이 운영하는 ‘AI 허브(Hub)’ 웹사이트를 통해 공개했다. 민간 기업이나 연구기관도 AI 학습에 쓸 수 있게 하기 위해서다. 여기에 공개된 데이터는 과기정통부가 만든 품질 기준을 충족하는 것들이다.)

Meanwhile, several government and public institutions—such as the Ministry of SMEs and Startups, the Seoul Metropolitan Government, and the Korea Expressway Corporation—have separately created their own AI training data, independent of MSIT, and published it on their own websites. The government has not even been able to grasp the full scope of which institutions are creating and releasing what AI training data, prompting MSIT to conduct a comprehensive survey since April. The BAI identified at least 26 institutions that have built 313 types of data. However, the budget spent on constructing these datasets has not been confirmed. (그런데 중소벤처기업부, 서울시, 한국도로공사 등 여러 정부·공공기관이 과기정통부와 별도로 제각기 AI 학습용 데이터를 만들어 자기 기관 웹사이트 등에 공개하고 있다. 정부도 어느 기관이 무슨 AI 학습용 데이터를 만들어 공개하고 있는지 전모를 파악하지 못해, 지난 4월부터 과기정통부가 전수조사를 하고 있다. 감사원은 최소 26개 기관이 313종을 구축한 것으로 파악했다. 다만 이 데이터들을 구축하는 데 예산이 얼마 들었는지는 확인되지 않았다.)

It was also found that many institutions created data without checking what AI training data MSIT or other agencies were producing, leading to significant duplication of investment. For example, MSIT spent 23.3 billion won on three types of data related to pills, oral health, and autonomous driving, yet three other agencies, including the Ministry of Food and Drug Safety, separately spent 840 million won on overlapping data. Similarly, MSIT spent 7.38 billion won on four types of image data—wild animals, household waste, concrete cracks, and eggs—while five other institutions, including the Seoul Metropolitan Government and the Korea Expressway Corporation, spent 610 million won separately to produce data that overlapped with MSIT's. (그런데 여러 기관이 과기정통부나 다른 기관이 AI 학습용으로 무슨 데이터를 만들고 있는지를 확인하지 않은 채로 제각기 데이터를 만들어, 다수의 중복 투자가 이뤄진 것으로 나타났다. 과기정통부가 알약, 구강, 자율 주행 관련 데이터 3종을 233억원을 들여 만들어 놨으나, 식품의약품안전처 등 3개 기관이 따로 8억4000만원을 들여 이와 겹치는 데이터를 만들어냈다. 과기정통부가 야생동물과 생활 폐기물, 콘크리트 균열, 달걀 등 4종의 이미지 데이터를 73억8000만원을 들여 만들어 놨는데, 또 서울시와 한국도로공사 등 5개 기관이 따로 6억1000만원을 들여 과기정통부 데이터와 겹치는 데이터를 만들어냈다.)

The BAI pointed out that this budget waste occurred because institutions did not share or coordinate their data construction plans with other agencies before proceeding. (감사원은 각 기관이 AI 학습용 데이터를 구축하기에 앞서 다른 기관과 구축 계획을 공유하거나 조정하지 않아서 이런 예산 낭비가 벌어졌다고 지적했다.)

The BAI also noted that of the 313 types of data built by 26 institutions independently of MSIT, 289 types (92.3%) were not originally constructed according to MSIT's quality standards. Among them, 283 types were built using either quality standards set by each institution itself or standards for general public data rather than AI training data, while 6 types were created with no quality standards at all. Additionally, 9 institutions accepted data delivered by construction companies without verifying it, raising doubts about whether those datasets met quality standards. (감사원은 또 26개 기관이 과기정통부와 별개로 구축한 데이터 313종 가운데 289종(92.3%)이 애초에 과기정통부의 품질 기준에 따라 구축된 데이터가 아니라고 지적했다. 283종은 각 기관이 자체적으로 정한 품질 기준을 적용했거나, AI 학습용 데이터가 아닌 공공 데이터 품질 기준을 적용해 만들어진 것이었다. 6종은 아예 품질 기준도 없이 만들어졌다. 또 이 가운데 9개 기관은 데이터 구축 업체가 납품한 데이터를 검증하지도 않고 받아들인 것으로 나타나, 각 데이터가 품질 기준을 충족했는지 의심됐다.)

Accordingly, the BAI commissioned the Korea Telecommunications Technology Association (TTA), a data quality certification body, to sample 6 types of data built by Gyeonggi Province and the Korea Expressway Corporation out of the 313 types and verify their accuracy. The results showed that all 6 types fell short of MSIT's quality standards. The image data produced by the Expressway Corporation, based on traffic surveillance camera footage nationwide, did not mark where vehicles were located in each image, making it unusable for AI training. The bulky waste image data built by the Seoul Metropolitan Government contained mislabeled files—for example, images of cardboard boxes or tables were labeled as "bags"—meaning that training AI on this data could actually introduce errors. (이에 따라 감사원은 데이터 품질 인증 기관인 한국정보통신기술협회에 의뢰해, 313종 가운데 경기도와 한국도로공사가 구축한 데이터 6종을 표본으로 뽑아 정확도를 검증해 봤다. 그랬더니 6종 모두 과기정통부의 품질 기준에 미달했다. 도로공사가 전국의 교통 상황 감시 카메라 영상을 바탕으로 만들어낸 이미지 데이터는 각 이미지의 어느 지점에 차량이 있는지를 표시해 놓지 않아서 AI 학습에 쓸 수 없는 것으로 나타났다. 서울시가 구축한 대형 폐기물 이미지 데이터는 종이 상자나 탁자인데 파일명이 ‘가방’으로 돼 있는 등 표기가 잘못돼 있어, AI에 이를 학습시키면 오히려 오류를 일으킬 수 있는 것으로 나타났다.)

Problems were also found in some of the 908 types of data released via AI Hub, which had been evaluated as meeting MSIT's quality standards. Of these, 213 types were confirmed to have been supplied by companies that have since gone out of business, and 11 of those types had received multiple complaints about errors in the data. However, MSIT closed these complaints without verifying whether the data actually contained errors, citing the reason that "the implementing agency had shut down." As a result, data that could cause errors when used for AI training has been left unchecked. (과기정통부의 품질 기준을 충족한 것으로 평가돼 AI 허브를 통해 공개된 데이터 908종의 일부에도 문제가 있는 것으로 나타났다. 213종은 데이터를 납품한 업체가 폐업 상태인 것으로 확인됐고, 이 가운데 11종은 데이터에 오류가 있다는 민원이 여러 건 접수됐다. 그러나 과기정통부는 해당 데이터에 실제로 오류가 있는지를 확인하지 않고 이 민원들을 ‘종결’ 처리해 버렸는데, ‘사업 수행 기관이 폐업했다’는 것이 이유였다. 이에 따라 AI에 학습시켰을 때 오류를 일으킬 수 있는 데이터가 방치되고 있는 것으로 드러났다.)

The BAI instructed MSIT to establish a system requiring all institutions to share and coordinate their AI training data construction plans with other agencies in advance, to set quality standards applicable to all training data built by government and public institutions, and to develop measures for post-management of already-released training data. (감사원은 과기정통부에 각 기관이 AI 학습용 데이터 구축 계획을 사전에 다른 기관들과 공유·조정하도록 하는 체계를 마련하고, 정부·공공기관이 구축하는 모든 학습용 데이터에 적용되는 품질 기준을 마련하며, 이미 공개된 학습용 데이터도 사후 관리하는 방안을 마련하라고 통보했다.)

item.title: Kim Min-seok "Ruined the presidential election," Jeong Cheong-rae "Betrayal trauma"... Ruling party's final debate turns into a slugfest (김민석 “대선 망쳐먹어” 정청래 “배신 트라우마”…與 마지막 토론 난타전)
item.description:
Kim Min-seok "Ruined the presidential election," Jeong Cheong-rae "Betrayal trauma"... Ruling party's final debate turns into a slugfest (김민석 “대선 망쳐먹어” 정청래 “배신 트라우마”…與 마지막 토론 난타전)

<<>> Candidates for the Democratic Party's leader engaged in fierce exchanges during the final TV debate before the party convention on the 12th, clashing over responsibility for past presidential election defeats, the Lee Jae-myung administration's single-stock leveraged exchange-traded fund (ETF), and housing supply issues. In particular, candidates Jeong Cheong-rae and Kim Min-seok traded emotionally charged remarks, accusing each other of "ruining the presidential election" and having "betrayal trauma." ()

At the debate held on SBS that day, Candidate Kim brought up Candidate Jeong's past "Bongyi Kim Seon-dal" remarks from the very start of the first initiative debate. Kim noted that the remarks had sparked conflict with the Buddhist community during the 20th presidential election, asking, "You refused to apologize and refused to leave the party, and instead criticized the candidate's side that demanded an apology—why did you do that?" When Jeong countered that his relationship with the Buddhist community is now good, Kim responded, "I didn't ask about the current relationship; I asked why you didn't apologize ahead of a crucial presidential election." (더불어민주당 당대표 후보들이 12일 전당대회 전 마지막 TV 토론회에서 과거 대선 패배 책임과 이재명 정부의 단일 종목 레버리지 상장지수펀드(ETF), 부동산 공급 문제 등을 놓고 거친 공방을 벌였다. 특히 정청래·김민석 후보는 서로를 향해 “대통령 선거를 망쳐먹었다” “배신 트라우마가 있는 것 같다”고 하는 등 감정 섞인 설전을 벌였다.)

Jeong immediately fired back over Kim's 2002 departure from the Democratic Party and his support for candidate Chung Mong-joon. "Kim Min-seok, calm your face," Jeong said. "You betrayed President Roh Moo-hyun in 2002 and left the party. You seem to have a lot of trauma from that betrayal." He added, "You keep trying to pin your defection talk on me, but it won't work. The more we talk about that time, the worse it gets for you, yet you keep bringing it up." (이날 SBS에서 열린 민주당 당대표 후보 토론회에서 김 후보는 첫 주도권 토론 시작부터 정 후보의 과거 ‘봉이 김선달’ 발언을 꺼냈다. 김 후보는 20대 대선 당시 이 발언으로 불교계와 갈등이 불거졌다며 “당시 사과도 거부하고 탈당도 거부하고, 오히려 요구한 후보 측을 비난했는데 왜 그랬느냐”고 했다. 정 후보가 최근 불교계와 관계가 좋다고 반박하자 김 후보는 “지금 관계가 어떠냐고 물은 것이 아니라 중요한 대선을 앞두고 왜 사과하지 않았느냐고 물은 것”이라고 했다.)

Kim responded, "I'm not at a disadvantage. I've apologized for everything I needed to." He added, "Just as prosecution reform becomes bone broth with no flavor if you overuse it more than three times, the same goes for your repeated betrayal talk." He then aimed at Jeong, saying, "You ruined the presidential election—why don't you apologize for that? Isn't that the real betrayal? Someone who engaged in such betrayal only responds to me with accusations of betrayal." (정 후보는 곧바로 김 후보의 2002년 민주당 탈당과 정몽준 후보 지지 문제로 맞받았다. 정 후보는 “김민석 후보님 얼굴 푸시고요”라며 “본인이 2002년 노무현 대통령을 배신하고 탈당하고, 배신한 것에 트라우마가 많이 있는 것 같다”고 했다. 이어 “저한테 탈당 얘기를 하면서 자꾸 덮어씌우기를 하려는 것 같은데 그래봐도 소용없다”며 “그때 이야기를 할수록 김 후보가 자꾸 불리할 것 같은데 자꾸 꺼낸다”고 했다.)

The two also clashed over each other's economic and policy competence. When Kim asked Jeong about his experience debating actual economic issues with the heads of the top four conglomerates and about U.S. AI companies' investment trends in Korea, saying, "I ask because it's clear you haven't done it," Jeong replied, "You seem to have a fairly severe confirmation bias." Jeong added, "If you become party leader, you'd know—there are many policy meetings with small and medium business owners and large corporation chairmen. I don't brag about meeting with conglomerate heads like that." (김 후보는 “저 별로 불리하지 않다. 사과할 것은 다 했다”며 “검찰 개혁도 세 번 이상 우려먹으면 물이 안 나오는 사골탕이 되듯 배신 이야기도 계속하시면 그렇다”고 했다. 그러면서 정 후보를 향해 “대통령 선거를 망쳐먹었는데 그에 대해서 왜 사과하지 않느냐. 그것이야말로 배신 아니겠느냐”며 “그런 배신적 행위를 하신 분이 저에 대해서 배신으로만 답변한다”고 했다.)

The two also engaged in a war of words over the meaning of the word "chiha" (congratulations/praise). Jeong took issue with Kim using the term toward him, saying, "Chiha is something a superior says to a subordinate. Treating people with such contempt, as if you're above them, will make the public frown. Please be careful." Kim countered, "What Jeong said about chiha comes from reading a Japanese dictionary. In Korean dictionaries, it's also used between equals." (두 후보는 상대의 경제·정책 능력을 놓고도 부딪쳤다. 김 후보가 정 후보에게 4대 기업 총수들과 실제 경제 현안을 놓고 토론한 경험과 미국 AI 기업의 국내 투자 동향을 물으며 “안 해본 것이 명확히 보이기 때문에 여쭤본 것”이라고 하자, 정 후보는 “확증편향 현상이 좀 심한 것 같다”고 했다. 정 후보는 “당대표를 하게 되면, 안 하셔서 모를 것 같은데 중소기업이나 대기업 회장들과 정책 간담회를 많이 한다”며 “대기업 총수들과 만나 얘기한 것을 그렇게 자랑하지 않는다”고 했다.)

The issue of introducing single-stock leveraged ETFs also turned into blame directed at Kim. During the common question segment, Kim said, "I apologize to the citizens who were concerned," and noted, "I happened to chair the meeting that passed the leveraged ETF." He explained that he presided over the Cabinet meeting because President Lee was abroad at the time, but added, "Since it was a matter under the economic team's purview, there was no special face-to-face briefing beforehand." (두 사람은 ‘치하’라는 말의 뜻을 놓고도 신경전을 벌였다. 정 후보는 김 후보가 자신에게 ‘치하한다’는 표현을 쓴 것을 문제 삼으며 “치하는 윗사람이 아랫사람한테 하는 것”이라며 “그렇게 사람을 무시하고 윗사람이 아랫사람 대하듯 하는 태도는 국민들이 눈살을 찌푸릴 것 같다. 주의해 달라”고 했다. 김 후보는 “정 후보가 치하에 대해 말씀하신 것은 일본식 사전을 읽으신 것”이라며 “한국 사전에서는 동등하게도 쓰인다”고 반박했다.)

Kim later said, "As someone who oversees state affairs on behalf of the president, I have no intention of saying 'I bear no responsibility,'" but added, "Raising political attacks against an individual does not seem appropriate." (단일 종목 레버리지 ETF 도입 문제도 김 후보의 책임론으로 번졌다. 김 후보는 공통 질문에서 “우려하셨던 국민 여러분께 죄송하다는 말씀을 드린다”며 “마침 레버리지 ETF를 통과시킨 회의를 제가 사회를 봤다”고 했다. 당시 이 대통령의 해외 출장으로 자신이 국무회의를 주재했지만 “경제팀 고유 사안이어서 사전에 특별히 대면 보고는 없었다”고 했다.)

Jeong targeted Kim, saying, "Many ordinary investors have been badly hurt by single-stock leveraged ETFs." He pointed out, "Looking at the Cabinet meeting agenda from April 21, the submitter is listed as Prime Minister Kim Min-seok, and Kim also presided over the meeting." He added, "Kim made a responsibility-avoiding remark saying 'I never directly ordered it,' but I'm glad he apologized a bit earlier." (김 후보는 이후 “전체 국정을 대통령을 대리해 통할하는 입장에서 ‘나는 책임 없다’고 하고 싶은 생각도 없다”면서도 “개인에게 정치적 공방을 제기하는 것은 적절해 보이지 않는다”고 했다.)

Jeong described the single-stock ETF as "an oxymoron, like hot ice cream," and said, "Trust is the foundation of the stock market. When there are things to hold accountable, strong measures may be necessary." In the second initiative debate, he continued to pressure Kim, saying, "Apologies also need timing." (정 후보는 “단일 종목 레버리지 ETF로 피멍 든 일반 투자자들이 많다”며 김 후보를 겨냥했다. 그는 “4월 21일 국무회의 법령안을 보면 제출자가 김민석 총리로 돼 있고 국무회의 주재도 김민석이 했다”며 “김 후보가 ‘내가 직접 지시한 적 없다’는 책임 회피성 발언을 했는데 조금 아까 사과해 다행”이라고 했다.)

On President Lee's pledge to supply 1.4 million housing units and the LH (Land and Housing Corporation) issue, the two candidates questioned each other's understanding of policy. When Jeong repeatedly asked, "Do you know how many tens of thousands of units out of the 1.4 million LH has to handle?" Kim responded, "What matters is the alternative," adding, "We need a housing New Deal that includes the state investing more responsibly in LH's finances." (정 후보는 단일 종목 ETF를 “뜨거운 아이스크림 같은 형용모순”이라고 표현하며 “주식은 신뢰가 기본이다. 문책할 일이 있으면 그런 강력한 조치도 필요하다고 본다”고 했다. 두 번째 주도권 토론에서도 “사과도 타이밍이 필요하다”며 거듭 김 후보를 압박했다.)

Kim later said, "The three of us debating shouldn't sink to the level of a quiz show," adding, "Everyone in the ruling camp knows LH faces financial difficulties and challenges in its business model." (이 대통령의 주택 140만호 공급 공약과 LH 문제에서도 두 후보는 상대의 정책 이해도를 문제 삼았다. 정 후보가 “140만호 가운데 LH가 몇 만호를 감당해야 하는지 아느냐”고 거듭 묻자 김 후보는 “중요한 것은 대안”이라며 “LH에 국가가 보다 책임 있게 재원을 투자하는 것을 포함한 주거 뉴딜을 해야 한다”고 했다.)

Jeong said, "Someone who served as prime minister seems to not understand housing policy, which could be the most important policy for winning the general election." He noted, "LH has to handle 550,000 units over five years—110,000 per year," citing workforce and fiscal conditions before adding, "I asked if you knew that, and you just gave irrelevant answers." (김 후보는 이후 “세 사람의 토론이 퀴즈 수준이 돼서는 안 된다”며 “LH가 재원상 어렵고 사업 방식이 어렵다는 것은 여권에 있는 사람들은 다 안다”고 했다.)

The tension continued over the Gwangju-South Jeolla semiconductor cluster. Kim said, "If Jeong takes over the party again, given overall party approval ratings or approval for the administration, restoring business confidence or the approval rating will be harder than it would be under other candidates." (정 후보는 “국무총리까지 하신 분이 총선 승리에 가장 중요한 정책일 수 있는 부동산 정책을 잘 모르시는 것 같다”고 했다. 그는 “LH가 5년간 11만호씩 55만호를 감당해야 한다”며 인력과 재정 여건 등을 거론한 뒤 “그걸 파악하고 있느냐고 물었는데 엉뚱한 이야기만 했다”고 했다.)

Jeong responded, "I'd appreciate it if Kim Min-seok showed some manners," adding, "Saying you'll actively help if you become party leader, while talking as if Jeong Cheong-rae is someone who shouldn't be in that role—isn't that discourteous?" (신경전은 광주·전남 반도체 클러스터 논쟁에서도 이어졌다. 김 후보는 “정 후보께서 당을 다시 맡게 되시면 전체적으로 당 지지율 또는 국정 지지율 때문에 기업의 안심이나 국정 지지율 회복이 다른 후보들이 되는 것보다 어려울 것”이라고 했다.)

They also clashed when Kim asked whether Jeong would accept the results of the preference vote at the party convention. Jeong said, "Under the guise of a question, you're going beyond conspiracy theories into political maneuvering—you seem very familiar with that." He added, "Why ask something so obvious? Isn't this purely to attack me? There must be some trick." He continued, "If Kim wins, of course I'd help. Ask what you should ask." (정 후보는 “김민석 후보는 예의를 지켰으면 좋겠다”며 “당대표가 되면 적극적으로 돕겠다고 하면서 정청래가 돼서는 안 될 사람처럼 이야기하는 것은 예의가 아니지 않나”라고 했다.)

Kim responded, "Thank you for saying you'd accept the preference vote and work together if I win. I'd do the same in the reverse situation." (김 후보가 전당대회 선호투표 결과에 승복할 것이냐고 묻는 과정에서도 충돌했다. 정 후보는 “질문을 빙자해서 음모론을 넘어 정치공작 차원에서 아주 익숙한 것 같다”며 “당연한 이야기를 왜 물어보느냐. 저를 공격하기 위한 목적 아니냐. 꼼수가 있겠지”라고 했다. 이어 “김 후보가 당선되면 당연히 돕는 것 아니겠느냐. 물을 걸 물으라”고 했다.)

Candidate Song Young-gil also focused his attacks on Jeong. Song brought up that Jeong, in a previous debate, had named "ending the insurrection" as the Lee Jae-myung administration's top national task, saying, "It's shocking that you have no awareness of the 123 national tasks officially confirmed by the Lee administration." (김 후보는 “선호투표에도 승복하시고 제가 승리한다면 함께 해주시겠다는 말씀을 주셔서 감사하다”며 “저도 역의 상황이 되면 그렇게 하겠다”고 했다.)

He added, "I understand 'ending the insurrection' was the Rebuilding Korea Party's No. 1 pledge—haven't you become too mentally swayed by that party?" When Jeong dismissed the way Song asked about the task numbers as a "quiz," Song retorted, "The public will see a ruling party leader who isn't being honest," "You're cheating," and "Aren't you ashamed?" (송영길 후보도 정 후보를 집중적으로 공격했다. 송 후보는 정 후보가 앞선 토론에서 이재명 정부의 국정과제 1호를 ‘내란 종식’이라고 답한 점을 거론하며 “이재명 정부가 공식 확정한 123개 국정과제 자체에 대한 인식이 없다는 게 충격”이라고 했다.)

The three candidates also sparred over whether to define the recent local and by-election results as a "victory." When Song asked Jeong, "Is there any basis for saying the party, government, and presidential office agreed to call it a victory?" Kim, the then-prime minister, said, "No," adding, "I never proposed calling it a victory." (이어 “내란 종식은 조국혁신당의 1호 공약으로 알고 있는데 정신적으로 너무 조국혁신당에 경도됐던 것 아닌가”라고 했다. 정 후보가 국정과제 번호를 묻는 방식 자체를 “퀴즈”라고 반박하자 송 후보는 “집권 여당 대표가 솔직하지 않다고 국민들이 볼 것” “반칙을 쓰신다” “부끄럽지 않느냐”고 했다.)

Jeong said, "I didn't say the party, government, and presidential office—I said the party and the presidential office," adding, "My conversations with the president are confidential." When his remarks overlapped with Song's, Jeong also said, "A man of your size shouldn't speak so lightly." (지난 지방·보궐선거 결과를 ‘승리’로 규정하는 문제를 놓고도 세 후보가 맞붙었다. 송 후보가 정 후보에게 “당정청이 조율해 승리로 하기로 했다는 근거가 있느냐”고 묻자, 당시 총리였던 김 후보는 “없다”며 “승리로 규정하자고 한 적 없다”고 했다.)

When asked what "tough love" advice they would give President Lee, the three candidates gave different answers. (정 후보는 “제가 당정청이라고 한 것이 아니라 당청이라고 했다”며 “대통령과 나눈 대화는 보안”이라고 했다. 송 후보와 말이 겹치자 정 후보는 “덩치는 크신 분이 너무 그렇게 가볍게 말하면 안 된다고 생각한다”고 하기도 했다.)

Song cited "housing again," saying, "We need to overcome the dichotomous thinking that real estate is speculation and stocks are investment." He argued that supply expansion must be accompanied by realistic tax and financial policies. (세 후보는 이 대통령에게 ‘쓴소리’를 한다면 무엇을 말하겠느냐는 질문에는 각기 다른 답을 내놨다.)

Kim said, "I'd tell him to cut back his schedule and take away his notebook." He explained, "The president, as the top leader, needs time to think and time for his health. I'd urge him to reduce his schedule and make room for reflection, health, and incognito time with citizens." (송 후보는 “이번에도 부동산 문제”라며 “부동산은 투기이고 주식은 투자라는 이분법적 사고를 극복해야 한다”고 했다. 공급 확대와 함께 세제·금융 정책의 현실화가 필요하다고 했다.)

Jeong cited diplomacy. He recalled former President Kim Dae-jung's remark that "for the national interest, you must even shake hands with the devil," and said, "I hope we can maximize diplomacy by properly leveraging both the independence-leaning and alliance-leaning factions." (김 후보는 “일정을 좀 줄이시라고 하고 수첩을 뺏겠다”고 했다. 그는 “최고지도자인 대통령에게 생각의 시간이 필요하고 건강의 시간도 필요하다”며 “일정을 줄이고 생각과 건강, 시민들과 함께하는 암행의 시간을 갖도록 권하고 싶다”고 했다.)

At the end of the debate, a segment was arranged for the three candidates to praise one another. Kim praised Jeong's quick wit and diligence, while Jeong praised Kim's situational judgment and coordination skills. In his closing remarks, Song said, "As Jeong said, we share the same roots," urging the three to join forces for the success of the Lee Jae-myung administration. The Democratic Party will elect its next leader at the party convention on the 17th. (정 후보는 외교를 꼽았다. 그는 김대중 전 대통령이 “국익을 위해서는 악마하고도 악수해야 한다”고 했던 말을 소개하며 “자주파와 동맹파를 적절하게 활용해 외교의 극대화를 했으면 좋겠다”고 했다.)

item.title: President Lee meets U.S. Ambassador Steel, expresses hope for a "strong bridge" in the Korea-U.S. alliance (李대통령, 스틸 美대사 만나 “한미동맹에 든든한 가교 기대”)
item.description:
President Lee meets U.S. Ambassador Steel, expresses hope for a "strong bridge" in the Korea-U.S. alliance (李대통령, 스틸 美대사 만나 “한미동맹에 든든한 가교 기대”)

President Lee Jae-myung met with U.S. Ambassador to South Korea Michelle Steel on the 12th and said, "I expect her to serve as a strong bridge for the development of the Korea-U.S. alliance." Ambassador Steel also said she would "work to promote mutual understanding and friendly cooperation" between the two countries. (이재명 대통령은 12일 미셸 스틸 주한 미국 대사와 만나 “한미 동맹 발전에 든든한 가교 역할을 해 줄 것으로 기대한다”고 말했다. 스틸 대사도 양국 간 “상호 이해와 우호 협력 증진을 위해 노력하겠다”고 했다.)

President Lee met Ambassador Steel at the "credentials presentation ceremony" held at the Blue House that day, during which he received credentials from foreign ambassadors stationed in Korea. It was their first meeting since Ambassador Steel arrived in the country last month. (이 대통령은 이날 청와대에서 열린, 주한 외국 대사로부터 신임장을 전달받는 ‘신임장 제정식’에서 스틸 대사를 만났다. 지난달 입국한 스틸 대사와는 첫 만남이다.)

After receiving the credentials from Ambassador Steel, President Lee greeted her with "Welcome." President Lee also took a commemorative photo with Ambassador Steel and her husband, attorney Sean Steel. (이 대통령은 스틸 대사에게서 신임장을 전달받은 뒤 “어서 오십시오”라고 환영 인사를 건넸다. 이 대통령은 스틸 대사, 스틸 대사의 남편인 숀 스틸 변호사와 함께 기념 촬영을 했다.)

During the conversation that followed the credentials ceremony, President Lee said, "I expect Ambassador Steel, who has a deep understanding of Korean culture and society, to serve as a strong bridge in further solidifying the Korea-U.S. alliance," adding, "Various pending issues between the two countries will be resolved smoothly through reasonable and active dialogue and cooperation, and through this, the bilateral relationship will become even more advanced." President Lee also reportedly described the Korea-U.S. alliance as "a blood alliance forged in blood." (이 대통령은 신임장 제정 뒤 이어진 환담 자리에서 “한국 문화와 사회에 대해 깊은 이해를 가진 스틸 대사가 한미 동맹을 더욱 굳건히 발전시켜 나가는 데 있어 든든한 가교 역할을 해 줄 것으로 기대한다”며 “양국 간 여러 현안도 합리적이고 적극적인 대화와 협력 과정을 통해 원만히 풀어나갈 수 있을 것이며, 이를 통해 양국 관계는 더욱더 고도화될 것”이라고 했다. 이 대통령은 “한미 동맹은 피로 맺어진 혈맹 관계”라고도 했다고 한다.)

Ambassador Steel said, "I am very pleased to take up my post in Korea," and "I will communicate broadly with the Korean government and people and work to promote mutual understanding and friendly cooperation between Korea and the United States." (스틸 대사는 “한국에 부임하게 되어 매우 기쁘다”며 “한국 정부 및 국민과 폭넓게 소통하며 한미 간 상호 이해와 우호 협력 증진을 위해 노력하겠다”고 했다.)

Since Ambassador Steel is fluent in Korean, light conversation also took place. President Lee reportedly asked Ambassador Steel how long it had been since she last visited Korea, and she replied that she had come the previous year as well. (스틸 대사가 한국어 구사에 자유롭다 보니 가벼운 대화도 오갔다. 이 대통령은 스틸 대사에게 ‘한국에 얼마 만에 왔느냐’고 물었고, 스틸 대사는 ‘지난해에도 왔었다’고 답했다고 한다.)

Ambassador Steel, born in Seoul in 1955, spent her middle and high school years in Japan and moved to the United States in 1975. After holding elected positions such as member of the California Board of Equalization, she served as a Republican member of the U.S. House of Representatives for four years starting in 2021. She is the second Korean-American U.S. ambassador to South Korea, following former Ambassador Sung Kim. (1955년 서울에서 태어난 스틸 대사는 중·고교 시절을 일본에서 보내고 1975년 미국으로 이주했다. 캘리포니아주 조세형평위원 등 선출직을 거쳐 2021년부터 4년간 공화당 소속 연방 하원 의원을 지냈다. 성 김 전 대사에 이어 두 번째 한국계 주한 미국 대사다.)

On the first weekend after her arrival late last month, Ambassador Steel visited Namdaemun Market in Jung-gu, Seoul, on the 1st, meeting citizens and eating hotteok. When a merchant mentioned having grandchildren, she conversed in Korean, saying, "I'm a grandmother too. I have four grandchildren." On the 2nd, she attended a service at Youngnak Church, which her parents are known to have attended. (스틸 대사는 지난달 말 입국 뒤 첫 주말인 1일 서울 중구 남대문시장을 방문해 시민을 만나고 호떡을 먹기도 했다. 손주가 있다는 상인에게 한국어로 “저도 할머니예요. 손주가 넷”이라며 대화를 나눴다. 2일엔 스틸 대사의 부모가 다녔던 것으로 알려진 영락교회를 방문해 예배를 드렸다.)

In addition to Ambassador Steel, President Lee also received credentials that day from Vanda Maria Dias Stelzer Sequeira, Ambassador of Portugal to South Korea; Jamal Al Suwaidi, Ambassador of the United Arab Emirates to South Korea; and Sean Hoy, Ambassador of Ireland to South Korea. (이 대통령은 이날 스틸 대사 외에 반다 마리아 디아스 스텔제르 세케이라 주한 포르투갈 대사, 자말 알 수와이디 주한 아랍에미리트 대사, 숀 호이 주한 아일랜드 대사로부터도 신임장을 받았다.)

item.title: Minister Kim Jeong-gwan: "Honam semiconductor plant's 2029 completion is already too slow" (김정관 장관 “호남 반도체 공장, 2029년 완공도 느린 것”)
item.description:
Minister of Trade, Industry and Energy Kim Jeong-gwan said on the 12th regarding the location of the Honam semiconductor cluster that "the government proposed the site to the companies first." At a plenary session of the National Assembly's Trade, Industry, Energy, SMEs and Startups Committee held that day, Minister Kim stated, "There was no pressure from the government or the ministry in deciding on Gwangju," adding this explanation. (김정관 산업통상부 장관이 호남 반도체 클러스터 입지와 관련해 “정부가 기업에 부지를 먼저 제안했다”고 12일 밝혔다. 김 장관은 이날 국회에서 열린 산업통상자원중소벤처기업위원회(이하 산자위) 전체회의에서 “광주로 결정하는 데 있어 정부나 산업부의 어떤 압박이 있지는 않았다”면서 이같이 말했다.)

On this day, the opposition party pressed for answers on the process of selecting the site for the Honam semiconductor cluster. People Power Party lawmaker Kim Do-eup asked, "Is it true that Samsung Electronics or SK hynix made the decision on the Honam semiconductor investment hub?" and further questioned, "Wasn't it made by the minister or President Lee?" Minister Kim responded, "The government proposed various sites, and the final selection was made by the companies." However, when lawmakers Woo Jae-joon and Seo Ji-young asked which candidate sites other than Gwangju were considered, Minister Kim did not provide specific answers. (이날 야당은 호남 반도체 클러스터 부지 선정 과정을 추궁했다. 국민의힘 김도읍 의원은 “호남 반도체 투자 거점 결정을 삼성전자나 SK하이닉스가 한 것이 맞나”라며 “장관 또는 이 대통령이 한 게 아니냐”고 물었다. 김 장관은 “다양한 부지를 정부가 제안했고 최종 선정은 기업이 했다”고 했다. 하지만 광주 이외의 후보지가 어디였는지 묻는 우재준·서지영 의원 등의 질의에 김 장관은 구체적으로 답하지 않았다.)

Regarding the 'blitzkrieg' goal of completing the first phase of a semiconductor fab (factory) on the site of the Gwangju military airfield by 2029, Minister Kim said, "From the perspective of the industry minister in charge of industry, manufacturing, and semiconductors, I believe even 2029 or 2030 is too slow." Responding to a question from People Power Party lawmaker Park Seong-min on whether the goal is actually achievable, Minister Kim said, "If we don't do it that way, we risk losing semiconductor competitiveness," adding this remark. (김 장관은 광주 군 공항 부지에 2029년까지 반도체 팹(fab·공장) 1차 완공을 한다는 ‘전격전’ 목표와 관련해, “산업·제조·반도체를 담당하는 산업부 장관 입장에서 봤을 때 2029년, 2030년도 느리다는 생각을 하고 있다”고도 했다. 김 장관은 과연 목표 달성이 가능한지 묻는 국민의힘 박성민 의원 질의에 “그렇게 하지 않으면 반도체 경쟁력을 잃을 것 같다”면서 이같이 말했다.)

Minister Kim also stated that discussions are underway to grant exceptions to the 52-hour workweek system within the Honam semiconductor cluster. In response to a question from Democratic Party lawmaker Kim Won-i about easing working hour regulations within the mega-special zone, Minister Kim said, "We are discussing various forms, including a white-collar exemption (a system to ease working hour regulations for high-income professionals) and the current flexible working hour system," adding, "We are closely consulting not only with industry and labor but also with the Ministry of Employment and Labor." (김 장관은 호남 반도체 클러스터에 주 52시간제 적용 예외 등을 주는 방안도 논의 중이라고 밝혔다. 김 장관은 메가특구 내 근로시간 규제 완화 논의에 대한 더불어민주당 김원이 의원의 질의를 받고 “화이트칼라 이그젬션(고소득 전문직 근로시간 규제 완화 제도)이나 현재 유연근무시간제도 등 다양한 형태에 대해서 논의 중”이라며 “산업계와 노동계는 물론 고용노동부와 머리를 맞대고 긴밀히 논의하고 있다”고 했다.)

However, Minister of Employment and Labor Kim Young-hoon, who attended the National Assembly's Environment and Labor Committee that day, said regarding the exception to the 52-hour workweek system that "it should be approached with caution." Minister Kim Young-hoon stated, "We will consider solutions that protect workers and also increase corporate productivity," while drawing the line on the exception to the 52-hour workweek system, saying, "Nothing has been decided by the government yet." (그러나 이날 국회 기후에너지환경노동위원회에 출석한 김영훈 고용노동부 장관은 주 52시간제 예외 적용과 관련해 “신중하게 접근해야 한다”고 말했다. 김영훈 장관은 “노동자를 보호하고 기업의 생산성도 올릴 수 있는 해법을 고민하겠다”면서도 주 52시간제 예외 적용과 관련해 “아직 정부에서 정해진 바는 없다”고 선을 그었다.)

item.title: Over a presidential approval rating lower than the party's… Song, Chung, and Kim clash (與보다 낮아진 대통령 지지율 놓고… 치고받은 宋·鄭·金)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung's state affairs approval rating has fallen, and in some surveys it has dipped below the approval rating of the Democratic Party of Korea, making the president's approval rating a hot topic in the party's national convention. All party leader candidates promised to restore the president's approval rating, but their diagnoses differed. Candidates Kim Min-seok and Song Young-gil cited real estate and stock market issues and discord between the party and the government as causes, while candidate Chung Cheong-rae, the immediate former party leader, pointed to the departure of hardcore supporters due to a decline in reformism. A political source said, "At a time when the Lee Jae-myung administration has just entered its second year in office, it is itself unprecedented for ruling party leadership contenders to publicly raise the issue of the president's falling approval rating." (이재명 대통령 국정 지지율이 하락하고 일부 조사에서 더불어민주당 지지율보다 낮아지면서 대통령 지지율이 민주당 전당대회 화두로 떠올랐다. 당대표 후보들이 일제히 대통령 지지율을 회복시키겠다고 약속했지만 진단은 달랐다. 김민석·송영길 후보는 부동산·주식시장 문제와 당정(黨政) 불협화음을 원인으로 꼽은 반면, 직전 당대표였던 정청래 후보는 개혁성 퇴조로 인한 강성 지지층 이탈을 원인으로 꼽았다. 정치권 관계자는 “이재명 정부가 집권 2년 차에 막 들어선 상황에서 여당 당권 주자들이 공개적으로 대통령 지지율 하락 문제를 꺼낸 것 자체가 이례적인 상황”이라고 했다.)

In a wireless automated response (ARS) poll released on the 12th by polling firm JoWon C&I, the president's approval rating fell 4.5 percentage points (p) from two weeks earlier to 42.9%, while the Democratic Party's approval rating rose 0.1p to 46.4%. In an ARS poll released by Realmeter on the 10th, the president's approval rating was also 43.3%, the lowest since taking office, and below the Democratic Party's approval rating (44.6%). In wireless phone interview surveys conducted by Gallup Korea and the four polling firms (Embrain Public, K-STAT Research, Korea Research, and Hankook Research), the president's approval rating recorded the low 50s, ahead of the Democratic Party. However, unlike the president's approval rating, which showed a decline in July, the Democratic Party's approval rating rebounded slightly during the same period, showing a tendency toward decoupling between the president's and the ruling party's approval ratings (for details on each poll, refer to the National Election Survey Deliberation Commission website). (여론조사 업체 조원씨앤아이가 12일 발표한 무선전화 자동응답(ARS) 조사에서 이 대통령 지지율은 2주 전보다 4.5%포인트(p) 떨어진 42.9%, 민주당 지지율은 0.1%p 오른 46.4%였다. 리얼미터가 지난 10일 발표한 ARS 조사에서도 이 대통령 지지율은 43.3%로 취임 후 최저였고, 민주당 지지율(44.6%)을 밑돌았다. 한국갤럽이나 여론조사 4사(엠브레인퍼블릭·케이스탯리서치·코리아리서치·한국리서치)가 실시하는 무선 전화 면접 조사에서는 이 대통령 지지율이 50%대 초반을 기록하며 민주당을 앞서고 있다. 다만 7월 하락세를 보인 이 대통령 지지율과 달리 민주당 지지율은 같은 기간 소폭 반등하는 등 대통령과 여당 지지율이 탈동조화하는 경향도 나타났다(각 여론조사의 자세한 사항은 중앙선거여론조사심의위원회 홈페이지 참조).)

Candidate Chung Cheong-rae appeared on Kim Eo-jun's YouTube channel on the 11th and said of the falling presidential approval rating, "It seems the core support base has turned its back," adding, "The moment Chung Cheong-rae becomes party leader, the president's approval rating will rise by more than 10 percentage points." On the 12th, he held a press conference at the National Assembly and said, "To raise the president's approval rating now, we need a reformist leadership—Chung Cheong-rae," and "With the power of party members, I will rebuild the reformist identity and restore the president's approval rating to over 60%." (정청래 후보는 지난 11일 김어준씨 유튜브에 출연해 대통령 지지율 하락에 대해 “핵심 지지층이 등을 돌린 것 같다”며 “정청래가 당대표가 되는 즉시 대통령 지지율이 10%p 이상 올라갈 것”이라고 했다. 12일에는 국회에서 기자회견을 열고 “지금 대통령 지지율을 끌어올리려면 개혁 지도부, 정청래가 필요하다”며 “당원들의 힘으로 개혁 정체성을 재건하고, 대통령 지지율을 60% 이상으로 회복하겠다”고 했다.)

In response, candidate Song Young-gil on the 12th on KBS Radio called Chung's analysis a "quack diagnosis." Song said, "It's the middle class that has drifted away, causing the rating to drop—how is it that the core support base turned its back?" adding, "The core of the decline is that real estate was mishandled and stock prices fell due to the impact of single-stock leveraged ETFs (exchange-traded funds)." He also said, "We must not touch real estate taxes." (그러자 송영길 후보는 12일 KBS라디오에서 정 후보의 분석을 “돌팔이 진단”이라고 했다. 송 후보는 “지금 중간층이 떨어져 나가서 (지지율이) 내려갔지, 무슨 핵심 지지층이 등을 돌려서 내려갔느냐”며 “지지율 하락의 핵심은 부동산을 잘못 다뤘고 단일 종목 레버리지 ETF(상장지수펀드) 영향으로 주가가 떨어졌기 때문”이라고 했다. 그러면서 “부동산 세금에 손대지 말아야 한다”고 했다.)

Candidate Kim Min-seok also appeared on Kim Eo-jun's YouTube channel the same day and diagnosed the falling approval rating, saying, "There was a loosening of the middle class, and amid the fierce infighting within the party over the national convention, supporters stepped back, wondering 'why are they fighting internally.'" Kim said, "Conservative momentum rose (after the June 3 local elections), and leveraged ETF and real estate issues also emerged at the same time," adding, "If I am elected, the discord between the party and government will disappear, the approval rating decline will stop, and after three months, 10 percentage points will be recovered." (김민석 후보도 같은 날 김어준씨 유튜브에 출연해 지지율 하락에 대해 “중간층의 이완이 있었고, 전당대회를 둘러싸고 당 내부에서 벌어진 치열한 공방에 ‘내부에서 왜 싸우지’ 하고 (지지층이) 물러났다”고 진단했다. 김 후보는 “(6·3 지방선거를 계기로) 보수층의 기세가 올라왔고, 레버리지 ETF와 부동산 문제도 같이 발생했다”며 “제가 당선되면 (당정 불협화음이 사라져) 지지율 하락이 멈추고, 3개월 후에 10%p가 회복된다”고 주장했다.)

Within the Democratic Party, diagnoses and outlooks also diverge. A lawmaker from the party leadership said, "The approval rating decline is due to a combination of tax reform related to real estate and stocks, single-stock ETFs, and the free-for-all of the national convention," adding, "Since the candidates are aware of the severity of the situation, whoever becomes leader will likely issue a message of unity and move to stabilize things." In contrast, another Democratic Party source said, "Given the abolition of the prosecution's supplementary investigation powers and the 'bus house' controversy, conditions exist for the president's and the party's approval ratings to fall together—it's just that the national convention has rallied supporters behind each candidate, making the party's approval rating look fine," adding, "Once a new party leader is chosen and time passes, the party's approval rating could also drop." (민주당 내에서도 진단과 전망이 엇갈린다. 당 지도부 한 의원은 “지지율 하락은 부동산·주식 관련 세제 개편과 단일 종목 ETF, 전당대회 난타전이 복합적으로 작용했기 때문”이라며 “후보들이 상황의 심각성을 인지하고 있는 만큼, 누가 대표가 되든 통합 메시지를 내면서 수습에 나서지 않겠느냐”고 했다. 반면 다른 민주당 관계자는 “검찰 보완수사권 폐지, ‘버스 하우스’ 논란 등으로 대통령과 당 지지율이 동반 하락할 만한 상황인데 전당대회로 각 후보 지지자들이 뭉치면서 당 지지율만 괜찮아 보이는 것일 뿐”이라며 “새 당대표가 뽑히고 시간이 지나면 당 지지율까지 빠질 가능성이 있다”고 했다.)

The party leader candidates also engaged in a slugfest in the final TV debate held that afternoon. Candidate Chung said, "Many ordinary investors are bruised and battered by single-stock ETFs," and "The law amendment and presiding over the cabinet meeting (regarding the launch of single-stock leveraged ETFs) were done by lawmaker Kim Min-seok (then prime minister)." Candidate Kim said, "Our narrow loss in the 2022 presidential election was because of Candidate Chung's 'Bong-i Kim Seon-dal' remark, which caused conflict between the party and the Buddhist community," and "Why did you refuse to apologize and refuse to leave the party at the time?" Candidate Song said, "Candidate Chung, during his time as party leader, without an accurate understanding of the administration's policy direction, went self-centeredly saying he would 'end the insurrection' and ended up reviving all the insurrectionist forces." (당대표 후보들은 이날 오후 열린 마지막 TV 토론에서도 난타전을 벌였다. 정 후보는 “단일 종목 ETF로 피멍 든 일반 투자자가 많다”며 “(단일 종목 레버리지 ETF 출시 관련) 법령안을 제출하고 국무회의를 주재한 것은 (당시 총리였던) 김민석 의원”이라고 했다. 김 후보는 “2022년 대선에서 우리가 근소하게 진 것은 정 후보의 ‘봉이 김선달’ 발언으로 (민주당과) 불교계가 갈등을 빚었기 때문”이라며 “당시 사과도 거부하고 탈당도 거부한 이유가 뭐냐”고 했다. 송 후보는 “정 후보가 (당대표 시절) 국정 기조에 대한 정확한 이해도 없이 자기 중심으로 ‘내란 종식’을 하겠다면서 내란 세력을 다 부활시켜 놨다”고 했다.)

item.title: Heads of Three Service Academies' Alumni Associations Tell Ahn Kyu-baek "Opposition to Hasty Merger of Service Academies" (3사 총동창회장들, 안규백에 “사관학교 졸속 통합 반대”)
item.description:
The alumni association presidents of the three service academies—Army, Navy, and Air Force—visited the Ministry of National Defense building in Yongsan, Seoul, on the 12th to convey their position to Defense Minister Ahn Kyu-baek that they "oppose the hasty merger of the service academies." The alumni associations of the Korea Military Academy (KMA), Korea Naval Academy (KNA), and Korea Air Force Academy (KAFA) began collective action last month on the 8th with a "National Rally Against the Merger of Service Academies" in front of the National Assembly in Yeouido, Seoul, but this is the first time the alumni association presidents have met directly with the defense minister to state their opposition. <<> Park Pan-jun, president of the KMA Alumni Association (retired colonel), Lee Beom-rim, president of the KNA Alumni Association (retired lieutenant general), and Hwang Seong-jin, president of the KAFA Alumni Association (retired lieutenant general), met with Minister Ahn for about an hour that afternoon in the reception room of the defense ministry building. Park appeared at the meeting wearing a black suit and black tie. Park said, "Since the KMA is being shut down, we are in mourning. Until this issue is resolved, we have decided to keep wearing mourning attire and carry out all official activities in that state." <<> At the meeting, the alumni association presidents are said to have primarily conveyed concerns from both within and outside the military that the merger of the service academies is being pushed forward unilaterally without sufficient consensus among active-duty and reserve military personnel and the general public. The atmosphere was reportedly one in which the alumni association presidents did most of the speaking while Minister Ahn listened and took notes. <<> At that gathering, Park Pan-jun, president of the KMA Alumni Association, is said to have brought up President Lee Jae-myung's remarks during the defense ministry's work report on the 5th, when he ordered the swift integration of the Army, Navy, and Air Force academies and stated, "The Korea Military Academy has been at the center of military coups three times in this country, yet no one has ever been held accountable." After the meeting, Park told reporters, "He said they weren't punished for the coups, but they all were punished. President Chun Doo-hwan couldn't even be buried in the national cemetery, and all those involved had their decorations stripped and were punished." He added, "How many juniors have suffered because of the (December 3) martial law and even had to give up their military careers?" <<> Park said, "Even if the KMA staged coups, what fault do the current cadets have?" and "If they say they're pushing this (merger) because of the martial law forces, then I told them I'd apologize to the president on behalf of the KMA Alumni Association president and asked them to arrange a meeting." If he were to meet President Lee, he said he would tell him, "Merging the service academies makes no sense, so please back off." <<> At the meeting, Lee Beom-rim, president of the KNA Alumni Association, is said to have stated, "With the liberation in 1945, the Navy was established first among the services, so the Naval Academy has a long history. There's no reason we should face punitive closure without any justification, is there?" He also reportedly said, "No matter which country's naval academy you visit in the world, not a single one is located away from the sea." The defense ministry announced last month a basic plan to establish a "National Defense University" at the inland site of Jaundae in Daejeon. <<> Hwang Seong-jin, president of the KAFA Alumni Association, is said to have remarked, "(Securing talent) isn't solved by merging the service academies; it's solved by improving treatment." He added, "Rather than a short-term physical merger, we could create a virtual campus suited to the era of the Fourth Industrial Revolution, where cadets can discuss with each other and receive education together." <<> As soon as the meeting, which lasted just over an hour, ended, the alumni association presidents and the defense ministry began to diverge in their accounts. After the meeting, the alumni association presidents said, "The minister promised to consider, as one option, a plan to pursue education reform while maintaining the current system of service academies." In other words, Minister Ahn had said he would also review maintaining the status quo. <<> However, the defense ministry stated, "It is not true that he said he would review maintaining the current system." Minister Ahn reportedly only said he would "listen to various opinions with an open mind." The defense ministry said, "While proceeding on the basis of establishing the National Defense University, we will achieve the best service academy education reform by reflecting the various opinions raised." <<> An official from the alumni association side who attended the meeting said, "Throughout the meeting, it was hard to shake the doubt about whether Minister Ahn himself truly has a serious understanding or sufficient knowledge to push forward such a momentous matter." Feeling that Minister Ahn did not have the authority, they said they requested, "Please arrange a meeting with President Lee." In response, the presidential office said no meeting has been scheduled yet. (육·해·공군 3군 사관학교 총동창회장들이 12일 서울 용산 국방부 청사를 찾아가 안규백 국방부 장관에게 “사관학교 졸속 통합을 반대한다”는 입장을 전했다. 육·해·공사 총동창회는 지난달 8일 서울 여의도 국회 본관 앞에서 ‘사관학교 통폐합 반대 국민 총궐기 대회’를 열며 집단행동을 시작했지만, 총동창회장들이 국방부 장관을 직접 만나 ‘반대 의사’를 밝힌 것은 이번이 처음이다.)

item.title: North Korea provokes with ballistic missile again after six days... flew over 700 km (北, 엿새만에 또 탄도미사일 도발… 700㎞ 이상 날아갔다)
item.description:
North Korea launched a ballistic missile into the East Sea on the 12th. This is another provocation just six days after it fired a short-range ballistic missile into the East Sea on the 6th. The National Security Office held an "emergency security situation review meeting" attended by relevant agencies such as the Ministry of National Defense and the Joint Chiefs of Staff on the same day, urging North Korea to halt its ballistic missile launches, calling them "violations of UN Security Council resolutions." (북한이 12일 동해상으로 탄도미사일을 발사했다. 지난 6일 단거리 탄도미사일을 동해로 발사한 지 엿새 만에 다시 도발에 나선 것이다. 국가안보실은 이날 국방부와 합참 등 관계기관이 참석한 가운데 ‘긴급 안보상황 점검회의’를 열어 북한의 탄도미사일 발사는 “유엔 안보리 결의 위반”이라며 중단을 촉구했다.)

The Joint Chiefs of Staff said it detected one ballistic missile launched from the Wonsan area toward the East Sea at around 6 a.m. that day. The JCS stated, "The detected North Korean missile flew more than 700 km, and the ROK-U.S. alliance is conducting a detailed analysis of the exact specifications." Although the maximum range of North Korea's short-range ballistic missile KN-23 (North Korea's version of the Iskander) is around 700–800 km, the JCS did not specify it as a "short-range ballistic missile." There is a possibility that North Korea reduced the range of a medium-range ballistic missile for launch, or test-fired a short-range hypersonic missile. (합동참모본부는 이날 오전 6시쯤 북한 원산 일대에서 동해상으로 발사된 탄도미사일 1발을 포착했다고 밝혔다. 합참은 “포착된 북한의 미사일은 700㎞ 이상 비행했으며, 정확한 제원에 대해서는 한미가 정밀 분석 중”이라고 했다. 북한 단거리 탄도미사일 KN-23(북한판 이스칸데르)의 최대 사거리가 700~800㎞ 안팎이지만, 합참은 ‘단거리 탄도미사일’이라고 명시하지 않았다. 북한이 준중거리 탄도미사일의 사거리를 줄여 발사하거나, 단거리 극초음속 미사일을 시험발사했을 가능성도 있다.)

According to Japan's Ministry of Defense, the ballistic missile launched by North Korea that day reached an apogee of 90 km. This is higher than the known apogee of 50–60 km for the existing KN-23, raising the possibility of a test of a hypersonic glide vehicle warhead at high altitude. Hong Min, a senior research fellow at the Korea Institute for National Unification, said, "There is a possibility that a test was conducted combining a hypersonic glide vehicle warhead with the body of the short-range ballistic missile KN-23." (일본 방위성에 따르면 이날 북한이 발사한 탄도미사일의 정점 고도는 90㎞였다. 기존 KN-23의 정점 고도로 알려진 50~60㎞보다 더 높아, 고고도에서 극초음속 활공체 탄두 시험을 했을 가능성도 제기된다. 홍민 통일연구원 선임연구위원은 “단거리 탄도미사일 KN-23 동체에 극초음속 활공체 탄두를 결합한 시험을 했을 가능성이 있다”고 했다.)

Yoo Ji-hoon, a research fellow at the Korea Institute for Defense Analyses (KIDA), said, "This launch could be a reliability verification of missiles supplied to Russia, or a performance improvement test reflecting problems identified on the Ukrainian battlefield." According to foreign media, Ukrainian intelligence authorities believe that North Korea has deployed a missile unit of around 90 personnel operating KN-23 series missiles to the front lines against Ukraine this month. (유지훈 한국국방연구원(KIDA) 연구위원은 “(이번 발사가) 러시아에 공급되는 미사일의 신뢰성 검증이나, 우크라이나 전장에서 확인된 문제점을 반영한 성능 개량 시험일 가능성이 있다”고 했다. 외신에 따르면 우크라이나 정보당국은 북한이 이달 들어 KN-23 계열 미사일을 운용할 90여 명 안팎의 미사일 부대를 대(對)우크라이나 전선에 배치하고 있다고 판단하고 있다.)

North Korea's latest provocation comes ahead of the ROK-U.S. joint exercise "Ulchi Freedom Shield" (UFS), which begins on the 17th. North Korea has historically reacted sensitively to the ROK-U.S. UFS exercises, calling them "rehearsals for invasion of the North." On the same day, North Korea also issued a statement in the name of First Vice Foreign Minister Kim Jong-gum claiming that the South Korean government's plan to introduce nuclear-powered submarines is "a serious challenge to (North Korea's) security and maritime sovereignty." (북한의 이번 도발은 오는 17일부터 시작되는 한미 연합연습 ‘을지 자유의 방패’(UFS)를 앞두고 이뤄졌다. 그간 북한은 한미의 UFS 연습이 ‘북침 연습’이라며 예민한 반응을 보여왔다. 북한은 이날 장금철 외무성 제1부상 명의로 우리 정부의 원자력 추진 잠수함 도입 계획이 “(북한의) 안전과 해상 주권에 대한 엄중한 도전”이란 담화도 냈다.)

item.title: President Lee's First Greeting with U.S. Ambassador Steel (李대통령, 스틸 美대사와 첫 인사 )
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung posed for a commemorative photo with U.S. Ambassador to South Korea Michelle Steel (left) and her spouse, attorney Sean Steel (right), at the credential presentation ceremony for foreign ambassadors to South Korea held at the Blue House on the 12th. During the conversation following the ceremony, Ambassador Steel said to the Korean-English interpreter seated by the Blue House, "I speak Korean, so you can speak in Korean," to which President Lee responded, "But your husband is here — would that be okay?" When President Lee remarked, "You speak Korean so well, the interpreter must be nervous," Ambassador Steel continued the light-hearted exchange by telling the interpreter, "Don't be nervous," according to the Blue House. (이재명 대통령이 12일 청와대에서 열린 주한 외국 대사 신임장 제정식에서 미셸 스틸(왼쪽) 주한 미국 대사, 배우자 숀 스틸(오른쪽) 변호사와 기념 촬영을 하고 있다. 제정식 후 환담에서 스틸 대사는 청와대 측이 배석시킨 한·영 통역을 향해 “제가 한국말을 하니 한국말로 하셔도 된다”고 했고, 이 대통령은 “남편분도 계신데 그러면 되겠냐”고 했다. 이 대통령이 “한국말도 잘하셔서 (통역이) 긴장되겠다”고 하자, 스틸 대사는 통역에게 “긴장하지 마세요”라며 담소를 이어갔다고 청와대는 전했다.)

item.title: Striking pro-Han allies while defending Jang... What's changed for Ahn Cheol-soo, and why? (친한 때리며 張 옹호… 달라진 안철수, 왜?)
item.description:
People Power Party (PPP) lawmaker Ahn Cheol-soo (Seongnam Bundang-gap, Gyeonggi) on the 12th targeted the pro-Han faction pushing for the reinstatement of independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon, arguing they should be "excluded from candidate nominations in the next general election." Ahn had previously voted in favor of impeaching former President Yoon Suk Yeol alongside the pro-Han faction and has been assessed as leaning toward a centrist line within the party. In opposition circles, some pointed to the pro-Han faction's attacks on Ahn during the insurrection special counsel trial as the cause, while others interpreted his move as potentially eyeing a bid in the next party leadership race or the Seoul mayoral by-election. <<> At a press conference at the National Assembly that day, Ahn said, "Those who serve a specific person outside the party (Han) and divide the party for that purpose should disappear from the People Power Party." He also called the pro-Han faction a "reinstatement movement group" and "lecca" (YouTubers who swarm trending events), adding, "They should be excluded from eligibility for support in the next general election." The remarks were interpreted as targeting certain pro-Han lawmakers facing disciplinary action from the party's ethics committee, as well as non-elected figures active as broadcast panelists. <<> In August last year, Ahn ran for party leader in the party convention, advocating a break with former President Yoon. However, when he recently appeared as a witness in the Daegu Mayor Choo Kyung-ho's insurrection special counsel trial and testified that on the day of martial law, then-PPP leader Han Dong-hoon had also instructed people to gather at the PPP headquarters before going to the National Assembly, he faced fierce criticism from the pro-Han faction. In response, Ahn held a press conference, opposed Han's reinstatement, and suggested Han launch a new party instead. <<> Among non-mainstream factions, some assessed Ahn's press conference that day as "a show of support for PPP leader Jang Dong-hyuk, who opposes Han's reinstatement." Ahn did not attend a press conference pushed by PPP lawmakers from Gyeonggi Province after the local elections demanding Jang's resignation, and on Constitution Day, he visited a rally at Seoul Olympic Park attended by a large number of hardline supporters. <<> A pro-Han lawmaker said, "Maybe Ahn has concluded that Jang's leadership will be prolonged and has started 'aligning with the Jang Dong-hyuk code.'" A senior PPP lawmaker said, "Ahn initially said he would run for the National Assembly's Foreign Affairs and Unification Committee chairmanship, but after Seoul Mayor Oh Se-hoon received a sentence in the first trial that would strip him of his mayoral position, he withdrew his intention to run," adding, "It appears to be a decision considering the Seoul mayoral by-election or the next party leadership." Ahn's side responded, "Mayor Oh's Supreme Court ruling hasn't even come out yet, so talking about a by-election is itself absurd and a breach of party discipline." (국민의힘 안철수(경기 성남분당갑) 의원이 12일 무소속 한동훈 의원의 복당을 추진하는 친한계를 겨냥해 “차기 총선 공천에서 배제해야 한다”고 주장했다. 안 의원은 친한계와 함께 윤석열 전 대통령 탄핵에 찬성했고, 당내에서도 중도 노선에 가깝다는 평가를 받아왔다. 야권에선 내란특검 재판 과정에서 친한계가 안 의원을 공격한 것을 원인으로 꼽으면서 안 의원이 차기 전당대회나 서울시장 보궐선거 출마 가능성을 염두에 둔 것 아니냐는 해석도 나왔다.)

item.title: Seven 'Seed Technologies' Selected as Next Growth Engine in the AI Era (AI시대 다음 먹거리 ‘7대 씨앗 기술’ 선정)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung said on the 12th, "We must seize the golden opportunity created by the semiconductor industry and prepare in advance for the next growth engine beyond the artificial intelligence (AI) era," announcing plans to foster seven cutting-edge technologies—small modular reactors (SMRs), nuclear fusion, renewable energy, quantum, space and aviation, advanced biotechnology, and core mineral, material, component, and equipment supply chains—as key future growth drivers. (이재명 대통령은 12일 “반도체 산업이 만들어 준 절호의 기회를 활용해 인공지능(AI) 시대, 그 다음 먹거리를 미리 준비해야 한다”며 소형 모듈 원자로(SMR)와 핵융합, 재생에너지, 양자, 우주·항공, 첨단 바이오, 핵심 광물·소재·부품·장비 공급망 등 7개 첨단 기술을 미래 성장 동력으로 집중 육성하겠다고 밝혔다.)

At the "Future Growth Engines: Seven SEED (Strategic Emerging Engines for Disruptive innovation) Briefing" held at the presidential office Cheong Wa Dae, President Lee stated, "Whether we become leaders enjoying limitless opportunities or laggards perpetually exposed to the risk of obsolescence depends on our choices." Cheong Wa Dae explained, "We named it SEED to signify 'seed industries' that require strategic investment." The president added, "I believe that the cutting-edge technology seeds we plant today will grow into towering trees and evolve into new mega projects in the future." (이 대통령은 이날 청와대에서 열린 ‘미래 성장 동력, 7대 SEED(시드·Strategic Emerging Engines for Disruptive innovation) 보고회’에서 “우리가 무한한 기회를 누리는 선도자가 될 것인지, 도태의 위험에 언제나 노출돼 있는 추격자가 될 것인지는 우리의 선택에 달려 있다”면서 이같이 말했다. 청와대는 “전략적 투자가 필요한 ‘씨앗 산업’이라는 의미에서 SEED라 명명했다”고 설명했다. 이 대통령은 “오늘 우리가 뿌린 첨단 기술 씨앗들이 미래에는 거대한 나무로 자라나서 새로운 메가 프로젝트로 자라나게 될 것으로 믿는다”고 했다.)

The briefing also presented targets such as landing on the Moon by 2030, achieving the world's No. 1 quantum chip manufacturing capability by 2035, and generating power through nuclear fusion in the 2030s. It also outlined plans to avoid repeating past failures where technologies were developed but commercialization and market creation fell through, by establishing public-private joint special purpose companies (SPCs) in sectors requiring large initial investments to pursue technology development and commercialization together. < (이날 보고회에서는 2030년 달 착륙, 2035년 양자칩 제조 역량 세계 1위, 2030년대 핵융합 전력 생산 같은 목표도 제시됐다. 기술 개발에 성공하고서도 사업화와 시장 창출에 실패했던 과거 사례를 반복하지 않도록 초기 투자 부담이 큰 분야에 민관 공동 출자 특수목적법인(SPC)을 세워 기술 개발과 상용화를 함께 추진한다는 방침도 밝혔다.)

item.title: 41 Countries Including South Korea, US, Japan Say "Pacific Missile Test Undermines Security of Neighboring Countries" (한·미·일 등 41국 “태평양 미사일 시험, 인접국가 안보 저해”)
item.description:
Forty-one countries, including South Korea, the United States, Japan, and major European nations, issued a critical statement on the 11th (local time) regarding China's recent submarine-launched ballistic missile (SLBM) test launch. The Chinese People's Liberation Army launched an SLBM with a range of over 10,000 km from a nuclear submarine in waters near China toward the South Pacific on the 6th of last month, carrying a mock warhead for training purposes. To prevent other countries from gathering intelligence, they notified Australia, New Zealand, and other nations near the impact zone of the launch plan only a few hours before the launch, sparking significant backlash. <<> In response, the U.S. State Department issued a "Joint Statement on Ballistic Missile Launch Notifications" on behalf of 41 governments on the 11th, urging "all states that launch intercontinental ballistic missiles (ICBMs), SLBMs, or space launch vehicles (SLVs), particularly nuclear-armed states, to provide notification of such launches at least 24 hours in advance." While not directly naming "China," the statement included language noting that "recent missile test activity in the Pacific region has not followed the standard practices adopted by most nations," which is interpreted as a pointed reference to the Chinese People's Liberation Army's SLBM launch. <<> The 41 countries stated, "Conducting tests of ballistic missiles with nuclear-capable capabilities without sufficient prior notification and detailed information is dangerous and undermines the peace and security of affected states adjacent to such tests," adding, "This increases the risk of miscalculation, undermines global stability and security, and is incompatible with the responsibilities that come with possessing long-range missile capabilities." They also said, "We will continue to work to hold accountable those states whose actions fall short of responsibility." <<> The specific specifications of the SLBM launched by China last month were not disclosed. At the time, Chinese media reported that the People's Liberation Army had tested the 'JL-3' (Julang-3) missile, which has the entire U.S. within its range, and the United States, Japan, Australia, and New Zealand immediately voiced opposition. <<> South Korea had refrained from publicly condemning China at the time but joined this joint statement. In response, South Korea's Ministry of Foreign Affairs stated that the statement was issued under U.S. leadership, saying, "As we have consistently emphasized the importance of strengthening the pre-notification system for ballistic missiles and space launch vehicles, we joined the joint statement based on our principled position." (한국·미국·일본과 유럽 주요국 등 41국이 11일(현지 시각) 최근 중국의 잠수함발사탄도미사일(SLBM) 시험 발사를 겨냥한 비판 성명을 냈다. 중국 인민해방군은 지난달 6일 중국 인근 해역의 핵잠수함에서 남태평양으로 훈련용 모의 탄두를 탑재한 사거리 1만km 이상의 SLBM을 발사했는데, 타국의 정보 수집을 막기 위해 호주·뉴질랜드 등 낙하 지점 인근 국가에 발사 몇 시간 전에야 발사 계획을 통보해 큰 반발을 샀다.)
